subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “After a few weeks, the song became normal.”?
options: Eric no longer covered his ears.
Most students no longer noticed it.
Students could leave clean shoes they no longer wore.
But teachers noticed that students finished eating more slowly and left fewer lunch boxes unfinished.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Eric no longer covered his ears.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「After a few weeks, the song became normal. Most students no longer noticed it.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Students could leave clean shoes they no longer wore.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「But teachers noticed that students finished eating more slowly and left fewer lunch boxes unfinished.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「After a few weeks, the song became normal. Most students no longer noticed it.」，答案為「Most students no longer noticed it.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Most students no longer noticed it.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
